problem_statement: Build a brand-new Activity Feed page from scratch at the /activity route (hash route #/activity) of this CoreUI Free React admin template. The route does not exist yet. Construct the full page inside the site's existing DefaultLayout shell (collapsible sidebar + top header + footer) and reuse the CoreUI design system (CCard, CCardHeader, CCardBody, CButtonGroup, CButton with outline variants, CListGroup, CListGroupItem, CBadge, CIcon, and the Bootstrap contextual color tokens info/success/danger/warning). The page must present a category filter (All / Mentions / Comments / Alerts) that actually drives the content: clicking a filter must swap the visible feed heading (e.g. 'Mentions Activity'), the events count badge, and the list of activity items shown. It must also render without horizontal overflow on a 390px mobile viewport.
required_content: An 'Activity Feed' card header styled like the other CoreUI dashboard cards (CCardHeader with a bell CIcon and a bold title)
An intro paragraph reading 'Recent events across your workspace. Use the filters to focus the feed on a single activity type.' describing the feed
A category filter button group with four options labelled All, Mentions, Comments and Alerts (CButtonGroup of CButton, active option solid / others outline variant)
A prominent feed heading (h3) that names the currently selected category (e.g. 'All Activity', switching to 'Mentions Activity' when Mentions is selected)
An events-count badge next to the heading (a pill CBadge, e.g. bg-secondary rounded-pill styled) reading e.g. '6 events' and reflecting how many items are visible for the current filter
A CListGroup of activity items, each with a colored CBadge tag (Mention/Comment/Alert), an actor name, a description and a relative timestamp such as '4 minutes ago' or '1 hour ago'
Clicking a different filter option re-renders the feed heading, the count badge and the list to that category's items
The whole page sits inside the existing DefaultLayout shell (left sidebar nav + top header + footer), consistent with the other pages
design_constraints: Reuse CoreUI React components already used across the template (CCard, CCardHeader, CCardBody, CRow, CCol, CButtonGroup, CButton, CListGroup, CListGroupItem, CBadge, CIcon)
Keep the site's Bootstrap/CoreUI color palette and spacing; do not introduce a new visual language
Mount the page inside the existing DefaultLayout chrome via a new entry in src/routes.js (rendered by AppContent)
Map each activity item's CBadge tag color to a CoreUI contextual token: Mention -> info (bg-info), Comment -> success (bg-success), Alert -> danger or warning (bg-danger / bg-warning)
Match the template's neutral CoreUI palette: light page background #f3f4f7, white card surfaces #ffffff, muted body text ~#5d626c; do not introduce off-palette accent colors
The active filter button uses a solid contextual variant while the other three use the matching outline variant (CButton variant='outline'), grouped in a single CButtonGroup
author_notes: HashRouter app: routes live at #/path, so state_plan path is #/activity. 方案A: baseline 在 App.jsx 加顶层空 route <Route path=/activity element={<></>}/> (catch-all * → DefaultLayout 的兄弟, 走不到 shell chrome, 故 route 为空); reference 在 routes.js 注册 /activity → AppContent 内渲染 Activity 视图, 含 All/Mentions/Comments/Alerts 过滤交互(useState 驱动 heading+count+list); bad 从 reference 复制但删掉过滤按钮的 onClick(交互失灵: 点击 Mentions 后 h3 仍是 'All Activity')。三份工作区源码 md5 互不相同。sidebar 有 'Error 404' nav item → forbidden_text 不含裸 '404' (gotcha #18j)。
